payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintains a reduced XOR basis (linear basis) as a list of numbers; for each new x, greedily reduces it by XORing with basis elements where the most significant bit is set, until either 0 (then output the combination via bitmask) or non-zero (then adds reduced x as new basis vector).
payload.rationale: The solution implements the standard linear basis for XOR operations: it iterates over stored values, reducing x when XOR yields a smaller number (i.e., clears the highest bit), and tracks the combination via ans bitmask; if x becomes 0, it reconstructs indices using the mask. This directly matches the bit_xor_trick subtype which covers XOR basis construction and queries.
